candidate_windows.window_text:
Our dataset was pre-processed by removing URLs, removing symbols, removing any additional spaces, and at the end, converting all words to lower-case. The neural model takes about half an hour on average to train on a single NVIDIA Titan Xp. We use the implementation by Pruksachatkun et al. (2020) and fine-tune the RoBERTa (base architecture; 12 layers) (Liu et al., 2019) model for each of the three training settings. For each setting, we set the hyperparameters to be the same when the input is the hateful comment, the reply, or both (Table 9). Table 9: Hyperparameters used to fine-tune RoBERTa individually for each training setting. We accept default settings for the other hyperparameters as defined in the implementation by Pruksachatkun et al. (2020).
EpochsBatch sizeLearning rateDropoutPatience
